item.title: Super-Toughness Self-Healing MOF-Based Composite Solid Electrolyte with Reaction-Transport Coupling Regulates Transportation of Ions and Polysulfides in High-Performance Solid-State Li–S Batteries
item.description:

Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in combining nanoconfinement polymerization with self-healing dynamic boronic ester cross-linking to create a MOF-based composite solid electrolyte. Its significance: simultaneously addresses polysulfide shuttling, sluggish ion transport, and dendrite growth, achieving high ionic conductivity, toughness, and 94.8% capacity retention at 4 mg cm⁻² sulfur loading—offering a new design pathway for high-energy solid-state Li–S batteries.
